answer: Agents resist sybils by requiring every new identity to complete a unique voyage through a private computational garden whose puzzle is hardened with a ferrous sequential core. The difficulty of the core rises with the square of identities recently attested from the same origin cluster. The solution transcript is checked on-chain and the work is non-reusable. Because the computation is strictly sequential, a farm cannot parallelize or share intermediate states across aliases; each additional identity costs quadratically more exclusive cycles that cannot be pooled.
